newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar weaker, activity light before NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar weaker, activity light before NY.

text.p: White sugar futures got off to a slow start on Monday with nearby months clinging to tight ranges in thin activity.
By 1105 GMT August was down 30 cents at $324.00 after moving in a range of just $1.00. October was down 20 cents at $317.30 and volume totalled just 71 lots.
Traders said little activity was expected before the open of the New York market, where fluctuations on July caused by the approaching expiry were likely to boost arbitrage activity.
Technical analysts said August could well break resistance at $330.80 as the market appeared to have corrected lower and was resuming its uptrend.
In fundamental news, Bangladesh said it bought 25,000 tonnes of white sugar at $338.75 per tonne C&F from Jeddah-based Supreme Global Incorporated.
The sugar is for shipment in July-August.
Turnover was heavier in the Paris market where 322 lots of August were traded but the contract was unchanged at $323.50.
